Morgan: Heads-up from HyperForward 30 they offered FRA rapid-rma staging + two routing options for a 48-unit H100 top-up: consolidated sea (14w) or expedited air (4w). Air premium ~+24%/unit; depot hold available. Manifest in drive.

Sanjay: Can we take a 16-unit air tranche into eu-west without impacting customer clusters?

Elena: We have one weekend install window in ~10 days. Can free ~12 GPUs by pausing dev jobs for 48h. Rack crew needs a 6h dock-to-rack window.

Tom (HyperForward): Recommend hybrid: 16 air (canary + cushion) + 32 sea. FRA depot can reserve kits with a 48h swap SLA if addendum signed and hold fee paid. We can pre-assign serial ranges to speed intake.

Morgan: Sounds reasonable. Ops, can you schedule a 4-unit air canary first and confirm customs docs (HS + invoice)? Also need transient burst quota for Dedicated for 48h during roll-in.

Sanjay: I'll schedule the canary after AWB + serial CSV. Sea bulk will route via AMS; expect ~4 business days for customs and kitting once landed.

Tom (HyperForward): Will DM proforma AWB and serial CSV tonight. Note: if addendum not signed, DOA replacements go via courier (5-10d). Depot swap only with signed SLA.

ops-bot: Added checklist: "attach HS 8471 doc + commercial invoice + importer license for FRA clearance".

Elena: I'll draft the canary runbook (burn-in, network test, quick perf check) and coordinate install crew.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Tom send AWB + serials (EOD) 2) Legal review SLA addendum 3) Ops schedule 4-node air canary + request 48h burst quota. Thanks. :thumbsup:
